name: calcium bicarbonate + sodium chloride
uses: Use Temporarily relieves symptons associated with sinusitis, cold, flu, allergies Including: Post nasal drip, sneezing, runny nose, nasal stuffiness Removes inhaled irritants, dust, pollen Helps reduce swelling of nasal membranes Moistens dry nasal passages Promotes nasal and sinus clearage
otcwarn: Do not use tablets if open or torn In case of eye contact, promptly irrigate eye with water for 10 minutes. Seek medical attention if irritation persists.
